Run the tests with the Makefile targets:

- **`make test-fast`** is the usual choice. It runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`, which skips the tests marked `postgres`. This matches the project's stored convention.
- **`make test`** runs the full suite with `pytest -q`, including the Postgres tests. Those presumably need a Postgres instance available.

I didn't run either target. I only read the Makefile.
